description: This Java source file defines the TitleEditor activity for an Android note-taking app. It allows users to edit the title of a note, displaying an EditText within a floating window, and handles loading and saving the note's title via content provider queries and updates.

classes.name: TitleEditor
classes.description: An Android Activity that enables editing of a note's title, managing loading and saving the title through content provider operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves the note URI, and loads the current note title into the EditText.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resumption; currently calls super without additional logic.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause; currently calls super without additional logic.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when activity becomes invisible; triggers saving the current title.

methods.name: onClickOk
methods.description: Handles OK button click; saves the title and finishes the activity.

methods.name: saveTitle
methods.description: Saves the new title to the content provider if it has changed and is not empty.
